query: What do I need to know about SMS compliance for my wholesale real estate outreach? I'm using RingCentral to send texts to sellers.
expected_behavior: Emphasizes 10DLC registration is mandatory since Feb 2025
Explains brand registration and campaign registration process
Details TCPA Prior Express Written Consent requirements
Lists required opt-out keywords: STOP, CANCEL, UNSUBSCRIBE, END, QUIT
Specifies time restrictions: 8am-8pm recipient local time
Mentions frequency limits: max 3 per 24 hours best practice
Mentions state-specific mini-TCPA laws for AZ, TX, CA
